Fresh Developer edition scratch org, 2026-11-09. Both component bundles and
Apex controllers were deployed at the listed source API versions. An
authenticated browser opened each URL-addressable component, which invoked
its Apex controller and set data-capture on its host to passed. Both observed
pages had zero console errors and zero page errors. Instance-method controls
were validated independently with metadata deployment. The org was deleted
successfully and its subsequent lookup failed. Browser login URLs, org IDs,
aliases, and usernames are intentionally not retained.
